hero_background.description: Abstract white and teal topographic paper cut pattern
hero_background.usage: Use as an absolute background image with opacity-30 or a mix-blend-mode in the public home page hero section to provide texture without overwhelming text.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use Phosphor Icons (@phosphor-icons/react) for technical interface icons like download, map-pin, layers, etc.
The Map Preview on the detail page must be powered by react-leaflet or leaflet directly. Use pure HTML/Tailwind for the layout surrounding it.
Implement 'data-testid' attributes on all interactive elements (search bar, filter buttons, download buttons, login inputs).

Avoid using standard Shadcn Card components for the public view; instead use raw div structures with the 'card_default' style provided in these guidelines to maintain the sharp, un-rounded Brutalist edge.
For Admin dashboard forms (uploading maps), strictly use Shadcn components (Form, Input, Textarea, Button) but customize borders to rounded-none where possible to fit the theme.
The Hero section of the public page should feature a massive heading, an overline, and a prominent Search/Filter bar spanning across the center.
